newsitem.title: USA: Ryan, Beck cuts qtly dividend to $0.01.
newsitem.headline: Ryan, Beck cuts qtly dividend to $0.01.

text.p: Ryan, Beck & Co Inc said on Tuesday it will cut its quarterly dividend to $0.01 from $0.05, due to the board's desire to grow the company's capital base.

"This adoption of a new dividend policy is consistent with our evolution as a firm over the past several years," Ryan, Beck Chairman Ben Plotkin said in a statement. "We have now made the transition from a company that paid out substantially all of its earnings in dividends to a firm that sees growth prospects which justify retention of earnings."
The dividend is payable May 5 to shareholders of record as of April 25.
Ryan, Beck shares closed down 1/4 to 4-1/4 on Tuesday.
